diagnosticHistory.details: Two failures exposed a test helper that applied aac_adtstoasc to already-normalized ISO-BMFF AAC packets, producing empty hashes. Packet-level FFprobe proved both output tracks contained 189 packets. The other failures were exact 3GP undefined-language and case-normalized MOV comment semantics.

diagnosticHistory.result: 8 passed in 27.0 seconds, followed by 46/46 affected AAC/remux regressions in 1.4 minutes
diagnosticHistory.resolution: AAC access-unit hashing now applies ADTS removal only to ADTS-bearing .aac and MPEG-TS inputs; non-ADTS containers hash their demuxed access units directly. Metadata keys are compared case-insensitively and the 3GP und mapping is asserted explicitly.

scope: This closes complex MPEG-TS- and FLV-origin field/payload mappings for every currently compatible Matroska, MPEG-TS, ISO-BMFF, and FLV destination. M-03 remains partial for equally complex AVI, WebM, and Ogg origins plus attached-picture dispositions.
